But the merge was a dead end: advertiser-name-helpers.js, the module every card (AdvertiserStatCard.jsx) and the detail drawer (AdvertiserDetailDrawer.jsx) actually render display names through, only ever read row.name/row.display_name, both empty on all 45 seeded rules rows, and row.name_source, which mergeRowWithIdentity never set. This is the actual live bug, found by reading the render path end to end rather than trusting that 'a fetch call exists' meant the surface was fixed.
